verdict.rationale: A live runtime probe confirms Capacities serves a genuine machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec at https://api.capacities.io/openapi.json, paired with a working bearer-gated REST API, directly satisfying the story; the docs also describe the REST API and Bearer auth. missing for 10: an explicit documentation page linking to/download-able copy of the spec (the docs subdomain's openapi.json paths 404) and independent/community confirmation of the spec's existence.
